title: Endpoint-based physical and transactional qualification of continuous response-space coupling
question: Does the continuous prepared-solve response-space coupling reach the independently defined physical fixed-interface endpoint while preserving transaction ownership during diagnostics and the existing nominal SWAP+ledger final handoff across a preregistered matrix of groundwater response strength, SWAP forcing/duration and admissible initialization side?

distinction_from_g21.g21_claim: Exact reproduction of the G17 accepted internal trajectory in one continuous prepared solve.
distinction_from_g21.g23_claim: Physical endpoint and transaction semantics without requiring internal Newton/path equivalence.
distinction_from_g21.forbidden_reinterpretation: A G23 pass must not be used to relabel G21 as passed.

algorithm.prepared_solve: exactly one prepare_time_step and one prepare_solve per arm
algorithm.xold: fixed for the entire prepared solve
algorithm.swap_observation: G16 diagnostic service only until endpoint convergence
algorithm.globalization: response-space factor-1/2 contraction on participant inadmissibility or merit failure
algorithm.reference_oracle: independent G08 fresh-solve affine groundwater response plus ordinary SWAP trial/discard root oracle

inherited_hard_stress_control.purpose: Retain the previously exercised status-6 and safeguard-contraction stress without duplicating it in the broad matrix.

excluded_known_envelope_points.scope: C2_HIGH_FORCING negative starts in GW_R075_STORAGE_STRESS, GW_R2_STORAGE_STRESS and GW_MIXED
excluded_known_envelope_points.reason: G08 classified exactly these three P4 arms TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE. They remain preserved envelope limitations rather than being retuned into G23.

per_arm_gates: Independent G08 oracle yields a finite positive groundwater response and a reference root.
Initial head is participant-admissible and E3 tangent is available when needed.
Continuous response-space loop reaches CONVERGED within the frozen outer/backtracking budgets.
Absolute external interface residual is <= 1e-15 m/s.
Final head differs from the independent reference root by <= 5e-10 m.
Exactly one prepared MODFLOW solve is used, XOLD remains bitwise fixed and finalize_solve occurs exactly once.
No finalize_time_step is issued by the research coupling loop.
All diagnostic SWAP observations are non-authoritative: no live candidate, no SWAP preflight, no ledger preflight, no committed-state mutation and zero ordinary publication trials.
After closing G16, exactly one ordinary final candidate reacquisition reproduces the cached final q to <= 1e-18 m/s.

Existing SWAP preflight -> ledger prepare/preflight -> SWAP commit -> ledger commit sequence produces revision 1, accepted time equal to the arm duration, ledger count 1 and ledger exchange equal to the final candidate bottom exchange.
No persistent MODFLOW transaction publication or crash-atomic multi-participant claim is made.
cross_arm_gates: For every scenario with both G08-qualified NEG and POS starts (all C0, C1 and C3 groundwater-regime combinations), both arms pass and their final heads differ by <= 5e-10 m.
Replay C0_MIXED_NEG from a fresh initialization and require bitwise-equal final head, final q, response status topology and committed ledger exchange.
The inherited G21E hard-stress STANDARD control remains physically reference-qualified.
The original G21 path-equivalence falsification remains unchanged.
No production solver, response-space, tangent, HCOF/RHS, retry or publication policy changes.
classification: QUALIFIED_ENDPOINT_MATRIX if every eligible executed arm, all same-scenario start-pair gates, replay, inherited hard-stress control and transaction postconditions pass.
PARTIAL_ENDPOINT_ENVELOPE if at least one preregistered eligible arm produces scientific evidence but fails a frozen endpoint/transaction gate; preserve the failing arm and do not shrink the matrix.
TECHNICAL_FAILURE only for build/download/API failures occurring before an arm produces scientific evidence.
pass_interpretation: A pass qualifies a bounded research claim that the continuous response-space coupling reaches the same independently defined physical fixed-interface endpoint across the executed eligible matrix and preserves current SWAP/ledger transaction ownership semantics. It does not admit production solver configuration, response-space policy, persistent MODFLOW publication, crash atomicity or HCOF/RHS semantics.
fail_interpretation: Preserve any eligible-arm failure. Do not alter the matrix, endpoint guard, residual guard, tangent scales, safeguard rule, solver configuration or reference oracle after observing results.

matrix_selection.rule: Execute every G08 P4 policy arm whose preregistered G08 result classification is CONVERGED.
matrix_selection.excluded_only: The three C2_HIGH_FORCING negative-start arms already classified TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE in G08.
matrix_selection.rationale: This replaces the narrower pre-implementation subset with the complete prior-qualified endpoint envelope and removes discretionary scenario selection before any G23 execution.

pre_execution_amendment.reason: Replace the initial 9-arm coverage subset with the complete G08 P4 endpoint envelope before implementation or execution.
pre_execution_amendment.evidence_boundary: No G23 implementation file or G23 execution existed before this amendment.
pre_execution_amendment.selection_rule: All and only G08 P4 policy_results with classification CONVERGED are executed.
pre_execution_amendment.resulting_matrix: 21 arms: C0 6, C1 6, C2 positive 3, C3 6. The only exclusions are the three previously TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE C2 negative arms.
